ItemSheet.EffectLightConfigHint: Configure token light (radius, color, animation); this effect will illuminate its bearer
ItemSheet.LightConfigHint: Both radii at 0 removes light from the effect. To turn it off temporarily, uncheck "Enabled" (the effect stays). Light is stored as regular effect changes (token.light.*) and applies to the bearer's token while the effect is active: light from an unequipped item or a suppressed effect goes out on its own.
ItemSheet.EffectSelfHint: Apply to owner when the item is used (@spentAp, @apCost, @overspent available)
ItemSheet.EffectAuraPayloadHint: Aura payload: applied to tokens inside the owner's aura
ItemSheet.EffectAuraConfigHint: Configure aura (radius, targets); this effect becomes the aura marker
ItemSheet.AuraConfigHint: Radius 0 removes the aura entirely (settings are lost). To turn it off temporarily, uncheck 'Aura enabled' — or right-click the aura icon in the effects HUD; the item's chat card has a toggle button too. While enabled, an aura region follows each of the owner's tokens and applies this item's payload effects (marked with the bullseye icon) to tokens inside. If no payload effects are marked, this effect's own changes are distributed instead. Enable 'Affects the bearer' for the owner to receive the aura.
ItemSheet.DamageFormulasHint: The formula next to a damage type is used by maneuvers of that type; if empty, the base damage formula applies.
ItemSheet.SpellBuildHint: This spell was built by the Constructor. Edit the build via the "Build a Spell" button in the window header; the fields below can be edited manually, but the cost is recalculated from the build on cast (a mismatch is whispered to the GM).
ItemSheet.ExperienceHint: Enter a positive number to grant XP, or a negative number (e.g. -5) to deduct XP.
ItemSheet.CurrencyItemHint: The denomination must match a currency key from world settings. When picked up/deposited, coins move into the wallet.
ItemSheet.ServiceHint: A service is intangible: it has no weight and is not added to inventory. On purchase, money is deducted and the item's Active Effects (if any) are applied.
